abs.label: Absolute
abs.tooltip: Returns the absolute value, removing the sign. Converts negative numbers to positive. Outputs |Input|.

add.label: Add
add.tooltip: Adds two numbers together. Outputs A + B.

adsrenvelope.label: ADSR Envelope
adsrenvelope.tooltip: Classic Attack-Decay-Sustain-Release envelope. Triggered by gate input, great for controlling parameter automation over time.

animation.label: Animation
animation.tooltip: Animates between start and end values over specified duration in seconds. Multiple easing curves and loop modes available.

atan2.label: ATan2
atan2.tooltip: Returns the angle from the positive X-axis to the point (X,Y) in π-radians. Useful for converting coordinates to angles.

audioanalyzer.label: Audio Analyzer
audioanalyzer.tooltip: Analyzes audio files and outputs frequency band levels (bass, mid, high). Load audio file and use outputs to drive visual effects.

autoexposure.label: Auto Exposure
autoexposure.tooltip: Automatically adjusts brightness based on image content. Keeps feedback effects balanced by preventing over-exposure or under-exposure.

automation.label: Automation
automation.tooltip: Records and plays back automation curves (with or without MIDI).

bloom.label: Bloom
bloom.tooltip: Adds glowing bloom effect to bright areas. Adjust threshold to control which areas glow, intensity for glow strength.

blur.label: Blur
blur.tooltip: Applies box blur effect to input. Separate X/Y blur controls allow for directional blurring or motion blur effects.

bpmclock.label: BPM Clock
bpmclock.tooltip: Generates rhythmic triggers at specified BPM. Includes tap tempo, subdivisions, and adjustable gate length for precise timing.

brickgame.label: Brick Game
brickgame.tooltip: Classic brick breaking game. Control with action inputs from MIDI/gamepad.

button.label: Button
button.tooltip: Simple button control that triggers action outputs when clicked. Useful for triggering multiple events at once.

camcordercrt.label: Camcorder CRT
camcordercrt.tooltip: All-in-one VHS camcorder / CRT feedback loop. Barrel distortion, chromatic aberration, scanlines, phosphor glow, brightness, vignette, plus spatial feedback with zoom, rotation and drift -- like pointing a camcorder at its own monitor.

ceil.label: Ceil
ceil.tooltip: Rounds up to the nearest integer. Always rounds toward positive infinity.

cellularautomata.label: Cellular Automata
cellularautomata.tooltip: Generates complex patterns using cellular automata rules like Conway's Game of Life.

channelsplitter.label: Channel Splitter
channelsplitter.tooltip: Splits a color input into separate RGBA number outputs. Useful for isolating and processing individual color channels.

checkerboard.label: Checkerboard
checkerboard.tooltip: Generates an alternating checkerboard pattern. Adjust frequency to control grid resolution and set custom colors for odd/even squares.

chromakey.label: Chroma Key
chromakey.tooltip: Green screen / blue screen effect. Key out specific colors and replace with background. Includes spill suppression and edge softness.

chromaticaberration.label: Chromatic Aberration
chromaticaberration.tooltip: Creates chromatic aberration effect by separating RGB channels with configurable offset and direction. Simulates lens distortion found in optical systems.

circle.label: Circle
circle.tooltip: Creates a circle shape with adjustable radius, position, and edge softness. Outputs both colored result and mask for compositing.

clock.label: Clock
clock.tooltip: Outputs real-world time values (seconds, minutes, hours, etc.). Useful for time-based animations and effects.

clockdivider.label: Clock Divider
clockdivider.tooltip: Divides incoming clock signals by specified amounts. Trigger on first event, then wait for specified number of events before triggering again.

color.label: Color
color.tooltip: Outputs a constant color value. Use the color picker control to select HSLA values. Connect to other nodes that accept color inputs.

colordither.label: Color Dither
colordither.tooltip: Posterizes an image to fewer color levels with ordered dithering to smooth the banding. Lower levels = more retro, dither softens the transitions.

colorize.label: Colorize
colorize.tooltip: Applies color tinting to grayscale or color images with adjustable blend modes.

colormapping.label: Color Mapping
colormapping.tooltip: Color grading tool. Dark areas use shadow color, bright areas use highlight color, with midtones blending between. Great for cinematic looks and stylistic color transformations.

colorshift.label: Color Shift
colorshift.tooltip: HSV color adjustment tool. Shift hue (color wheel rotation), adjust saturation (color intensity), and modify value (brightness).

contrast.label: Contrast
contrast.tooltip: Adjusts image contrast and brightness. Values above 1.0 increase contrast, below 1.0 decrease it.

cosine.label: Cosine
cosine.tooltip: Generates cosine wave patterns with adjustable frequency, phase, and amplitude. Similar to sine but 90° phase shifted.

cosinegradient.label: Cosine Gradient
cosinegradient.tooltip: Maps a float to color via Bias + Amp*cos(2π(Freq·t + Phase)). Per-channel control.

counter.label: Counter
counter.tooltip: Counts up or down when triggered. Useful for cycling through values, or using rotary encoders.

debug.label: Debug
debug.tooltip: Probes number values at any point in the image. Samples the bottom-left corner of the resulting text overlay. For debugging purposes.

dither.label: Dither
dither.tooltip: Ordered dithering. The mask (0–1) controls brightness — the dither pattern determines which pixels in each tile get the Light vs Dark color.

divide.label: Divide
divide.tooltip: Divides A by B with built-in division by zero protection. Outputs A ÷ B.

domainwarp.label: Domain Warp
domainwarp.tooltip: Warps input UVs using layered simplex noise. Multiple iterations feed the warp back into itself for increasingly organic distortion.

drawingcanvas.label: Drawing Canvas
drawingcanvas.tooltip: Interactive drawing canvas with pen, eraser, line, rect, circle, and fill tools. Symmetry modes, brush opacity, and keyboard shortcuts when canvas is focused.

edgedetection.label: Edge Detection
edgedetection.tooltip: Detects edges using convolution filters (Sobel, Prewitt, Laplacian) applied to RGB channels separately for true color edge detection.

emboss.label: Emboss
emboss.tooltip: Creates embossed 3D-like effect by highlighting edges and depth information. Try with Text and Overlay Layer Blend.

erode.label: Erode
erode.tooltip: Contracts bright areas. Opposite of dilate operation.

euclideanrhythm.label: Euclidean Rhythm
euclideanrhythm.tooltip: Generate Euclidean rhythms with beat count and rotation controls for each lane.

feedback.label: Feedback
feedback.tooltip: Accesses the previous frame from render history. Useful for feedback effects and temporal processing.

feedbackmix.label: Feedback Mix
feedbackmix.tooltip: Variable Time Feedback with a built in mix for simple motion-blur-like effect.

fisheye.label: Fisheye Lens
fisheye.tooltip: Applies fisheye lens distortion effect. Positive values create barrel distortion, negative creates pincushion distortion.

floor.label: Floor
floor.tooltip: Rounds down to the nearest integer. Always rounds toward negative infinity.

fractalnoise.label: Fractal Noise
fractalnoise.tooltip: Fractal Brownian Motion - layers multiple noise octaves for complex natural textures.

gamepad.label: Gamepad
gamepad.tooltip: Interfaces with connected game controllers. Outputs analog stick positions, trigger values, and button states.

gamma.label: Gamma
gamma.tooltip: Applies a gamma power curve to the image. Values above 1.0 brighten midtones, below 1.0 darken them. Alpha is unaffected.

geissflow.label: Geiss Flow
geissflow.tooltip: Classic Geiss-style vector field distortion with feedback. Pushes pixels around using swirling flow fields for organic, fluid-like effects.

glitch.label: Glitch
glitch.tooltip: Scanline displacement with randomized RGB channel splitting. Syncs to BPM or manual trigger.

grid.label: Grid
grid.tooltip: Creates a regular grid pattern. Adjust size for spacing, thickness for line width, and colors for lines vs background.

halftone.label: Halftone
halftone.tooltip: Creates retro halftone dot patterns based on input brightness. Adjust dot size and spacing for different print-like effects.

heighttonormal.label: Height to Normal
heighttonormal.tooltip: Converts a grayscale height map into a normal map for 3D lighting effects.

houndstooth.label: Houndstooth
houndstooth.tooltip: Generates a houndstooth pattern with adjustable scale and offset.

hsla.label: HSLA
hsla.tooltip: Combines Hue, Saturation, Lightness, and Alpha values into a color using HSL color space.

hue.label: Hue
hue.tooltip: Extracts the hue (color) of the input image.

imagegif.label: Image/GIF
imagegif.tooltip: Loads static images or animated GIFs. Drag and drop files or click to browse. Automatically handles aspect ratio and animation.

juliaset.label: Julia Set
juliaset.tooltip: Renders parametric Julia fractals. Change the C parameter to explore different Julia sets. Renders as a gradient, or use as a texture mapping effect in map mode.

kaleidoscope.label: Kaleidoscope
kaleidoscope.tooltip: Creates kaleidoscope effects by reflecting input in triangular segments. Choose source segment and style for different patterns.

kuwahara.label: Kuwahara
kuwahara.tooltip: Painterly smoothing filter. Picks the smoothest quadrant around each pixel, preserving edges while creating an oil-painting effect.

layerblend.label: Layer Blend
layerblend.tooltip: Blends two input layers with various blend modes (multiply, screen, overlay, etc.).

lerp.label: Lerp
lerp.tooltip: Linear interpolation between A and B based on factor T. When T=0, output is A. When T=1, output is B.

levels.label: Levels
levels.tooltip: Remaps the tonal range of the image. Input levels clip and stretch the incoming range; output levels set the target black and white points.

lineargradient.label: Linear Gradient
lineargradient.tooltip: Generates a linear color gradient between two colors. Adjust angle to control gradient direction.

luminosity.label: Luminosity
luminosity.tooltip: Extracts brightness information from color input. Outputs perceptually-weighted luminance as a number value.

lyapunov.label: Lyapunov
lyapunov.tooltip: Lyapunov fractal (sin² map) with 3D shading. Radial mapping: radius → A, angle → B. Type a sequence like AB, AABAB, A6B6.

maininput.label: Main Input
maininput.tooltip: References the global Main Input panel. Configure video and audio sources in the left panel. Multiple nodes can reference the same input.

mandelbrot.label: Mandelbrot
mandelbrot.tooltip: Renders the famous Mandelbrot fractal. Renders as a gradient, or use as a texture mapping effect in map mode.

max.label: Max
max.tooltip: Returns the larger of two values. Useful for clamping minimum values.

micline.label: Mic/Line In
micline.tooltip: Analyzes live microphone input for frequency content. Click to request microphone permission. Great for audio-reactive visuals.

min.label: Min
min.tooltip: Returns the smaller of two values. Useful for clamping maximum values.

mirror.label: Mirror
mirror.tooltip: Creates mirror reflections along X and/or Y axes.

modulo.label: Modulo
modulo.tooltip: Returns the remainder of A divided by B. Useful for creating repeating patterns and cycles. Outputs A mod B.

mosaic.label: Mosaic
mosaic.tooltip: Creates a mosaic effect by dividing the input image into a grid of cells. Supports square, hexagon, triangle, and Voronoi cell shapes with adjustable size, randomness, borders, and colors.

motionblur.label: Motion Blur
motionblur.tooltip: Blurs the image along a direction vector, simulating camera or object motion.

mouseinput.label: Mouse Input
mouseinput.tooltip: Outputs the live position and button state of the mouse cursor over the editor.

multiply.label: Multiply
multiply.tooltip: Multiplies two numbers together. Useful for scaling values or applying gain. Outputs A × B.

muxevent.label: Mux (Event)
muxevent.tooltip: Switches between 4 color inputs using next/prev/random buttons.

muxnumber.label: Mux (Number)
muxnumber.tooltip: Selects between 4 color inputs based on a number input (0-3, wraps around).

note.label: Note
note.tooltip: Just a way to add comments to a workspace :^)

number.label: Number
number.tooltip: Outputs a constant numeric value. Adjust with the slider control or connect to number inputs on other nodes.

offlineoutput.label: Offline Output
offlineoutput.tooltip: Renders frames offline at any resolution and FPS. Exports lossless PNG sequences for artifact-free video production.

oscillator.label: Oscillator
oscillator.tooltip: Generates various waveforms (sine, square, triangle, etc.) at specified frequency. Includes real-time waveform display and phase control.

output.label: Output
output.tooltip: Main output node for rendering and display. Shows result on screen, provides recording capabilities, and frame history control. Connect your effect chain here.

palette.label: Palette
palette.tooltip: Per-pixel OKLCH palette generator. Feeds one color through 8 harmonious variations. Connect spread, shift, curve, lightness and chroma to oscillators or audio for animated palettes.

perlinnoise.label: Perlin Noise
perlinnoise.tooltip: Generates smooth, natural-looking noise patterns. This effect won an Oscar in Tron!

perspective.label: Perspective
perspective.tooltip: Applies perspective transformation with adjustable corner positions for 3D projection effects.

phyllotaxis.label: Phyllotaxis
phyllotaxis.tooltip: Generates natural spiral patterns found in plants like sunflower seed arrangements and pine cones.

pixelsort.label: Pixel Sort
pixelsort.tooltip: Sorts pixels by brightness in variable-length chunks with hash-randomized boundaries. Classic glitch art.

polarcoords.label: Polar Coordinates
polarcoords.tooltip: Converts between Cartesian and Polar coordinate systems. Supports standard and logarithmic polar transformations with adjustable scaling.

polkadot.label: Polka Dot
polkadot.tooltip: Repeating dot pattern with center-sampled color. Each dot samples its center point, quantizing continuous inputs into atomic per-dot colors. Supports grid or staggered layouts.

polygon.label: Polygon
polygon.tooltip: Generates a regular polygon shape with configurable number of sides, radius, rotation, and edge softness. Outputs both a color image and a mask for further compositing.

posterize.label: Posterize
posterize.tooltip: Reduces the number of color levels in the input image, creating a posterized effect. Adjustable levels, dithering, and gamma correction for fine-tuning.

power.label: Power
power.tooltip: Raises base to the power of exponent. Handles negative bases safely. Outputs Base ^ Exponent.

prideflag.label: Pride Flag
prideflag.tooltip: Generates various pride flags with horizontal stripes or a chevron design. Select from multiple flags using the dropdown menu.

pythagorean.label: Pythagorean
pythagorean.tooltip: Calculates the hypotenuse using Pythagorean theorem: √(A² + B²). Useful for distance calculations from world coordinates.

radialblur.label: Radial Blur
radialblur.tooltip: Blurs the image radially outward from a center point, creating a zoom or explosion effect.

radialgradient.label: Radial Gradient
radialgradient.tooltip: Generates a radial gradient between two colors, centered at specified coordinates with adjustable radius. Choose loop mode for gradient behavior beyond the radius.

random.label: Random
random.tooltip: Outputs a pseudo-random float value between the specified Min and Max range. The Seed input allows for different random sequences.

randomfire.label: Random Fire
randomfire.tooltip: Fires action events randomly based on Temperature. Higher temperature = more frequent firing.

randomhurl.label: Random Hurl
randomhurl.tooltip: Generates fully uncorrelated RGB noise with independent random values for each color channel at every pixel.

reframerange.label: Reframe Range
reframerange.tooltip: Maps number input values through customizable ranges for parameter control.

regionabsolute.label: Region (Absolute)
regionabsolute.tooltip: Crops the input to a rectangular region using absolute coordinates. Choose background color, tile, or mirror tile for areas outside the crop rectangle.

regionsized.label: Region (Sized)
regionsized.tooltip: Crops the input to a rectangular region using center position and size. Choose background color, tile, or mirror tile for areas outside the crop rectangle.

repeater.label: Repeater
repeater.tooltip: Repeats a rectangular region from the input in a grid pattern. Define the source region and how many rows/columns to repeat.

rgba.label: RGBA
rgba.tooltip: Combines four number inputs into a single RGBA color. Connect separate red, green, blue, and alpha values.

rotate.label: Rotate
rotate.tooltip: Rotates the input image around its center. Angle in π-radians (1.0 = 180°) - positive clockwise, negative counter-clockwise.

rotozoom.label: Rotozoom
rotozoom.tooltip: Applies a dynamic rotozoom effect to the input image, combining rotation and zooming with sinusoidal modulation for a fluid, animated transformation.

saturate.label: Saturate
saturate.tooltip: Multiplies the saturation of an input color. 0 = fully desaturated (grayscale), 1 = unchanged, >1 = hypersaturated.

saturation.label: Saturation
saturation.tooltip: Extracts the saturation component from an input color. Outputs a float value between 0 (gray) and 1 (fully saturated).

scatter.label: Scatter
scatter.tooltip: Scatters randomized copies of the input across the plane with blue-noise spacing. Each copy can be jittered, rotated, flipped, and scaled. Overlap mode checks neighboring cells for seamless edges (cost: 3 → 27 samples per pixel).

screencapture.label: Screen Capture
screencapture.tooltip: Captures your screen or application windows. Modern browsers may require user permission for screen sharing.

shakycam.label: Shaky Cam
shakycam.tooltip: Adds camera shake effects with adjustable intensity and frequency.

sharpen.label: Sharpen
sharpen.tooltip: Enhances edge definition and detail in the input image.

sierpinski.label: Sierpinski Triangle
sierpinski.tooltip: Generates a Sierpinski triangle fractal with adjustable zoom and detail.

simplelight.label: Simple Light
simplelight.tooltip: Applies a simple diffuse lighting effect to a normal map texture.

simplex.label: Simplex Noise
simplex.tooltip: Generates improved noise patterns with better visual properties than Perlin noise.

sincfilter.label: Sinc Filter
sincfilter.tooltip: High-quality antialiasing filter using the sinc function. Provides sharp, artifact-free filtering with adjustable kernel size and cutoff frequency.

sine.label: Sine
sine.tooltip: Generates sine wave patterns with adjustable frequency, phase, and amplitude.

sliderule.label: Slide Rule
sliderule.tooltip: Visual slider interface for manual parameter control with customizable ranges.

slimemold.label: Slime Mold
slimemold.tooltip: Simulates Physarum slime mold (Jones, 2010). Thousands of agents wander a grid, each sniffing for scent trails with 3 forward sensors. They turn toward the strongest scent (Attract) or away from it (Repel), drop scent when they move, and the scent slowly diffuses and fades. Networks, veins, spots, and stripes emerge from just these rules. Sensor Angle = how wide the sensors spread. Rotation Angle = how sharply agents turn. Sensor Offset = how far ahead they sense (pattern scale). Trail Decay = how fast scent fades. Based on "Characteristics of Pattern Formation and Evolution in Approximations of Physarum Transport Networks" by Jeff Jones, Artificial Life 16(2), 2010.

smoothcounter.label: Smooth Counter
smoothcounter.tooltip: Like Counter, but smoothly interpolates toward the target value. Good for smooth fades, camera moves, etc.

smoothstep.label: Smoothstep
smoothstep.tooltip: Hermite interpolation between two edges. Returns 0 below Edge A, 1 above Edge B, and a smooth curve in between. Essential for soft masks, easing curves, and shaping signals.

spiral.label: Spiral
spiral.tooltip: Creates spiral patterns with adjustable turns, thickness, and size.

star.label: Star
star.tooltip: Generates star shapes with customizable points, inner radius, and rotation.

stargate.label: Star Gate
stargate.tooltip: Time-displacement effect that creates a split stargate-like motion effect.

static.label: Static
static.tooltip: Generates TV static/noise effect. Adjust density for grain amount and speed for animation rate.

stepsequencer.label: Step Sequencer
stepsequencer.tooltip: Multi-step sequencer with programmable patterns. Set values for each step and control playback speed.

stretchskew.label: Stretch/Skew
stretchskew.tooltip: Applies stretching and skewing transformations to distort the input image geometry.

stripes.label: Stripes
stripes.tooltip: Generates rotating stripe patterns with adjustable phase, frequency and rotation.

subtract.label: Subtract
subtract.tooltip: Subtracts B from A. Outputs A - B.

supersampling.label: Super Sampling
supersampling.tooltip: Averages several samples per-pixel to anti-alias. Fixes zoomed-out jaggies and sparkles.

text.label: Text

font_family.default: Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Palatino, serif
font_family.label: Font

text.tooltip: Renders text as texture with font selection and styling options. Great for titles and dynamic text displays.

threshold.label: Threshold
threshold.tooltip: Converts input to binary output based on threshold value. Above threshold outputs high value, below outputs low value.

tile.label: Tile
tile.tooltip: Repeats the input image in a tiled pattern. Use slide to offset rows or columns for brick-like patterns.

translate.label: Translate
translate.tooltip: Moves/shifts the input image by X and Y amounts. Positive X moves image left, positive Y moves image down (UV sampling offset).

triggeredcolor.label: Triggered Color
triggeredcolor.tooltip: Outputs a new random color each time it is triggered.

triggeredrandom.label: Triggered Random
triggeredrandom.tooltip: Outputs a new random value within the specified range each time it is triggered.

tunnel3d.label: Tunnel
tunnel3d.tooltip: Raymarched demoscene tunnel with twists and turns. Camera flies through a curved tube textured with the input.

variabletimefeedback.label: Variable-Time Feedback
variabletimefeedback.tooltip: Variable frame delay effect. Delay amount can be modulated for complex temporal effects and transitions.

vibrance.label: Vibrance
vibrance.tooltip: Boosts saturation of muted colors while protecting already-saturated areas. Unlike Saturate, vibrance is gentle on skin tones and vivid colors.

video.label: Video
video.tooltip: Loads video files with playback controls. Includes audio analysis outputs (bass, mid, high) and speed control. Supports common video formats.

vignette.label: Vignette
vignette.tooltip: Darkens or brightens the edges of the image. Strength controls intensity, radius controls where the effect begins.

wallpaper.label: Wallpaper
wallpaper.tooltip: Generates mathematical wallpaper patterns with various symmetry groups.

wave.label: Wave
wave.tooltip: Wave distortion. Rotation controls wave direction. Amplitude controls strength, frequency controls density, phase offsets the wave.

wavefold.label: Wavefold
wavefold.tooltip: Steepens gradients and makes them ping-pong when they hit the ceiling. Higher drive = more folds = more repeating bands of detail from a single gradient.

webcam.label: Webcam
webcam.tooltip: Captures live video from your webcam. Click to request camera permission. Use the Mirror option to control horizontal flipping.

whirlandpinch.label: Whirl & Pinch
whirlandpinch.tooltip: Combines whirl (spiral twist) and pinch (scale) distortions. Adjust center position and effect strength. Negative pinch is cool!

worldcoordinates.label: World Coordinates
worldcoordinates.tooltip: Outputs the world UV coordinates as separate X and Y values. Useful for positional calculations and custom effects.

worleynoise.label: Worley Noise
worleynoise.tooltip: Creates cellular/organic patterns based on Voronoi diagrams. Insect-wing patterns.

xypad.label: XY Pad
xypad.tooltip: Interactive XY controller with physics. Right-click-drag to place gravity wells or tethers. Drag distance sets strength/radius.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.tooltip: Scales the input image. Values >1 zoom in, <1 zoom out.
